queries:
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT invoice_number,
         COUNT(*) AS line_item_count,
         SUM(derived_product_cost) * 1.0 / SUM(derived_total_cost) AS ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
)
SELECT invoice_number, line_item_count
FROM inv
WHERE ratio > (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM inv);

SELECT AVG(invoice_ratio) AS average_ratio
FROM (
  SELECT invoice_number,
         AVG(derived_product_cost * 1.0 / derived_total_cost) AS invoice_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
);
SELECT AVG(derived_product_cost * 1.0 / derived_total_cost), COUNT(*) FROM Invoice_Line_Items
SELECT SUM(derived_product_cost) * 1.0 / SUM(derived_total_cost) AS average_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items
